answer_1.quote: The goal of this paper is to explore whether different types of evidence are reflected in language models' confidence and responses... we examined how changes in the informativeness and reliability of evidence affect the confidence and response of language models.

answer_2.quote: we used accuracy (ACC) and Expected Calibration Error (ECE)... we estimated the confidence of language models using verbalized confidence, token probability, and sampling.

answer_4.quote: We did not conduct a human evaluation as a baseline in this study as our focus was on aligning language models with ideal Bayesian epistemology.
